auditDescription: The hourly check of the server: firewall, SSH, certificates, permissions and services. No secrets.
ownerDescription: What has to be true before Helena is reachable from the internet.
edgeDescription: Cloudflare Access in front of helena.volition.one. Helena checks every request from the tunnel again itself.

check.tunnel_edge: Cloudflare Access is configured in Helena

check.auth_second_factor: Owner has a second factor (TOTP or passkey)

check.files_backups: Database dumps readable only by their service

edge.configured: Set up: requests from the tunnel are checked
edge.notConfigured: Not set up: the tunnel entry refuses everything
edge.teamDomainHint: From Cloudflare Zero Trust → Settings, ends in .cloudflareaccess.com.
edge.audiencesHint: The AUD tag of the Access application for helena.volition.one, 64 characters. One per line.
edge.allowedEmailsHint: Optional: only these email addresses, even if the Access policy admits more. One per line. Required for the Cloudflare sign-in.
edge.signInTitle: Sign in to Helena with the Cloudflare sign-in
edge.signInDescription: Signing in to Cloudflare Access as an allowed identity signs you in to Helena without another password, for at most 24 hours and never longer than the Access session. Access is then the only sign-in: require a second factor there (passkey/Touch ID or an authenticator app). The terminal still asks for its code.
edge.signInNeedsSetup: Needs the team domain, the AUD and at least one allowed identity.
edge.signInNeedsProof: The tunnel entry has no proof for Helena yet: run cloudflare/install.sh --apply entry-token on the server, then restart the API and the web app.
edge.homeDescription: On the public address, Helena checks whether {home} answers from this device and then switches there: directly over the home network, without the detour through Cloudflare. The home network sign-in signs you in there. Chrome asks once for access to the local network.
edge.homeDescriptionGeneric: On the public address, Helena checks whether the home network address answers from this device and then switches there: directly over the home network, without the detour through Cloudflare.
edge.homeNotSetUp: No home network address set up (HELENA_HOME_URL, cloudflare/switch_origin.py --home-host).

signIns.title: Sign-ins without a password
signIns.description: Through the Cloudflare sign-in and the home network sign-in, refused ones included.
